texts.text: A clerk on the Soulrest customs bench told me the Drowned Court has been paying outlanders to carry its books, and paying well, because it will not put its own people on the road. He said it as though it were a joke about the Court and not about the road.

Undersexton Aveline Rell has given me a sealed quarterly return to carry from Soulrest to the Court's factor in Gideon. She pays a hundred and twenty in advance, which is more than the work is worth, and she asked twice whether anyone had spoken to me on the stair.
Left and right turn the page. Confirm on a name in the margin to go to it.
